262-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
262-4687-5296.description:
Activate Elemental Mastery by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

967-2557-3809-3899-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

480-6981-7077-8095.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

3861-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

643-3413-6446.description:
Activate Silvar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Silvar ability.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-7753.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
2292-6972-7607.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

5153-6568-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-6568-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-5147-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-5147-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

321-399-777-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1329-3338-5060-7112.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
457-1329-3338-5060-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4826-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

338-360-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-3197.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-6106-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Electroduplicate and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Electroduplicate copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

969-1270-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

38-659-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-1879.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1479-1671-3908.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

224-1525-2783-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-2783-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers when it dies, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Nesting Dragon trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

1365-2511-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2511-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3426-4050-4772.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

500-3277-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-3277-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Izzet Chronarch and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1068-2660-4377.manaNeeded: {9}{U}{U} the first turn, with {4}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1068-2660-4377.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from your library.
Repeat from step 3.

3129-3209-4050-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

203-565-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
203-565-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Anoint, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

2034-3035-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Nadier.
Nadier leaves the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Elf Warrior tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.

1719-3525-3664.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3525-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

2440-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Sliver you control.
Repeat.
